title: Camp Big Timber

services.name: Summer camp
services.desc: Cub Scout Summertime Day Camp is an adventure designed just for boys and girls in 1st to 5th grade (and beyond as a volunteer!), filled with hands-on fun, outdoor exploration, and unforgettable summer memories. This year’s DINO-MITE! theme takes intrepid adventurers on a prehistoric journey where they explore, experiment, and discover in a safe, supportive environment led by trained staff and volunteers. Day campers enjoy a wide variety of activities, including archery and BB shooting to build focus and confidence, nature and outdoor skills through hands-on exploration, and STEM activities featuring creative experiments and problem-solving inspired by dinosaurs and fossils. blurb: Camp Big Timber is a multi-use camp located in Elgin, right near Randall Road and I-90 West. Built in the 30’s, The camp hosts 3 building used for rentals; The Main Lodge, DeMoon Family Lodge and Ansel. The Lodge is a Dining Hall styled building with a 3 season porch and multipurpose meeting room that can be used for activities and lodging.
